thread:
Elaine K.: quick follow-up from the security/privacy segment of today's all-hands. capturing Qs on SOC2/ISO, private deployment timeline, audit exports, and KMS/BYOK. pls reply with short notes or owners.

Sanjay R.: exec ask: specific owners + brief timelines. customers want a one-pager on private vs hosted guarantees.

Mateo G.: Private/VPC status: early access signup opens in Q3; GA target Q4. network checklist: CIDR, peering or PrivateLink choice, egress allowlist to control-plane endpoints. will publish terraform examples.

Lin P.: SOC2/ISO: readiness work underway. SOC2 readiness target end-Q2; audit window Q3. ISO27001 scoping starts Q2. need evidence automation for several controls to reduce manual pulls.

Priya (Legal): data residency question: yes, we can export archives to customer-owned EU buckets; need contract clause and proof of controls. i'll draft language for the template.

Mateo G.: audit export quick example for ops (will be put in runbook):
aws s3 sync s3://redwood-audit/2026-05/ s3://customer-evidence-bkt/allhands-18512/ --storage-class STANDARD_IA

AuditBot: automation note: starting standardized audit tags (audit.env, audit.correlation_id) next sprint; this will make evidence pulls deterministic.

Elaine K.: action items: 1) Lin to own SOC2 control map + runbook, 2) Mateo to publish VPC network doc + terraform, 3) Priya to add contract clause for customer archives, 4) OpsBot to add export script to runbook and list retention defaults. please update by EOD next week.

OpsBot: linked docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2-readiness and https://docs.redwood.ai/private/onboarding. ticket created: SEC-2032.

Sanjay R.: thanks all, leaving this open for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
